notes: Foreword: The purpose of this exercise within the ideonomical division "Phenomena" is to check the [validity, efficiency, sufficiency, and power] of the divisional list "208 Major Universally Investigable Dimensions Of Scientific Phenomena" in the case of the specific chemical phenomenon 'activity'. How good is the list as a whole, and also how do its individual items fare? The photograph cuts off after item 71.
